name: Mizutani Tadao
source:
[url=/c88594]Mizukami Maria[/url]'s father.
At first Tadao had only had boys in quick succession, so when Maria was born, he was extremely happy, because she was the daughter he had always dreamed of.
Tadao is excessive worried about his daughter safety. For example, once when Maria didn't come home by 7 pm, he called the police. He always takes a photo of his daughter Maria on her birthdays and saves them in an album.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20001018095504/http://www1.odn.ne.jp/d-xx/lineup/gizen/chara.htm]official website[/url].]
